Spring Valley II is supported by TVA’s April 8, 2026 published record of decision for 200 MWac and a 161 kV substation. Current Panthera page still says 178 MW and summer-2026 construction / early-2028 completion; EIA plant 66858 reports 200 MW and February 2028 with approvals pending. Event dates the ROD publication, not a made-up COD. Operator branding and project-scope conflict remain explicit.

Alcazar 2 is NYISO C24-094 / C26-0006, 150 MW / 600 MWh / four hours, not the prior 100 MW. These queue entries are not additive. The broader site is 250 MW / 1,000 MWh; NYSERDA’s opened public summary explicitly links C24-093/C24-094 and targets 2029, versus the queue December 2028 COD. Whole-site imagery and NYSERDA map coordinates are qualified, not a claimed phase-only boundary. Town final scope includes 40 acres with about 15 acres of BESS/substation; those scopes are not silently equated.

Alta Casa queue 1922 distinguishes 515.418 MW battery component from 500 MW export, targeting October 21, 2031 at Tesla 500 kV. Native power uses export rating with explicit basis. Arida plant 63841 has 370 MW solar plus a 370 MW battery; CAISO 1522 caps combined export at 370 MW. The plant is near Laughlin, not Apex. EIA June 2029 and CAISO September 2027 conflict, and the PUCN July 2025 list’s old 2024 target is stale. No sum of component capacity, assumed four-hour duration, NV Energy ownership or separate Arida 2/3 capacity.

The older ERCOT transmission-planning PDF corroborates a rounded 150.7 MW; current GIS supplies precision. No MWh or parcel is established.
